name: settings-text-size-common
description: The page applies the settings of a start document of a project that holds the common text size, and it sends the theme and then the menu language to the host once; it refuses the document whose project holds the text size and a project write of the text size without a call.
reason: The calls setTheme and setMenuLanguage apply to the window of the native host, which the Go producer does not run (docs/spec/cases/page-wire/README.md#producer-runs).
